entities.summary: Francesco Berlinghieri (1440–1501) was a Florentine scholar and humanist who lived during the fifteenth century. He promoted the value of classical Greek learning and was one of the first to print a text based on Ptolemy's Geography. Berlinghieri studied poetry under the tutelage of Cristoforo Landino.
